31.text: These are also called proofs for the existence of God, not in the sense of proofs in the natural sciences, but rather in the sense of "converging and convincing arguments", which allow us to attain certainty about the truth.
31.notes: Sentence only, not the whole paragraph. Sentence 2 of 3 (rest: the ways start from the physical world and the human person). Ch. 12 line 27.
